--- select_tvf_hint_tablesample.sql
SELECT * FROM app.f(1, x => 2) @{test_hint=1} TABLESAMPLE RESERVOIR (2 ROWS)

    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.Star{
        Star: 7,
      },

    From: &ast.From{
      From:   9,
      Source: &ast.TVFCallExpr{

          Idents: []*ast.Ident{

              NameEnd: 17,

              NamePos: 18,
              NameEnd: 19,
              Name:    "f",
            },
          },
        },
        Args: []ast.TVFArg{
          &ast.ExprArg{
            Expr: &ast.IntLiteral{
              ValuePos: 20,
              ValueEnd: 21,
              Base:     10,
              Value:    "1",
            },
          },
        },
        NamedArgs: []*ast.NamedArg{
          &ast.NamedArg{
            Name: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 23,
              NameEnd: 24,
              Name:    "x",
            },
            Value: &ast.IntLiteral{
              ValuePos: 28,
              ValueEnd: 29,
              Base:     10,
              Value:    "2",
            },
          },
        },
        Hint: &ast.Hint{
          Atmark:  31,
          Rbrace:  44,
          Records: []*ast.HintRecord{
            &ast.HintRecord{
              Key: &ast.Path{

                  &ast.Ident{

                    NameEnd: 42,

                  },

                ValuePos: 43,
                ValueEnd: 44,
                Base:     10,
                Value:    "1",
              },
            },
          },
        },
        Sample: &ast.TableSample{
          TableSample: 46,
          Method:      "RESERVOIR",
          Size:        &ast.TableSampleSize{
            Lparen: 68,
            Rparen: 75,
            Value:  &ast.IntLiteral{
              ValuePos: 69,
              ValueEnd: 70,
              Base:     10,
              Value:    "2",
            },
            Unit: "ROWS",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}
